d:
In this episode of Baby's first bear market, Krishna sits down with Abid Hassan, founder of Sensibull. From blowing up 80% of his savings in one trade to going 100% into FDs and government bonds, Abid shares why he believes this market is dangerously inflated, how most people are underestimating the risk ahead, and why trading is more about self-awareness than making money.
They dive deep into:
• ⁠ ⁠Should young investors worry about market crashes?
• ⁠ ⁠Why the current Nifty levels don't make sense
• ⁠ ⁠The myth of stock markets reflecting real economies
